steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each queue's answer time and waiting count are placed through the day.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 queue is above its answer-time target

findings.title: Answer time above target for an interval
Abandonment above its limit
findings.fix: Add cover or a callback option

findings.title: Waiting count rising for three intervals
findings.fix: Check the cause before the limit

outcome.notChecked: Contacts not in the export; the customer's experience of the wait.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] queue-callback:12  Answer time above target for an interval.
       Fix: Add cover for the interval.
[medium] queue-chat:19  Abandonment above its limit.
       Fix: Add cover or a callback option.
[low] queue-tier2:26  Waiting count rising for three intervals.
       Fix: Check the cause before the limit.
Not checked: Contacts not in the export; the customer's experience of the wait.
pros: Checks an interval where answer time exceeds the target, abandonment exceeds its limit, or the waiting count rises for three intervals in a row.
cons: Not checked: Contacts not in the export; the customer's experience of the wait.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-queue-monitor skill on the records for this review.
